summary: ZOOZ Strategy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the effectiveness of a previously disclosed 1-for-20 reverse share split of its ordinary shares. The reverse split took effect on June 1, 2026, with shares trading on a split-adjusted basis under the same symbol ZOOZ on Nasdaq and TASE. A new CUSIP number was assigned. This is a routine corporate action and not a special situation event; it does not involve acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change.
